title: ononis spinosa subsp. masquillierii
intro: Ononis spinosa subsp. masquillierii, commonly known as the Spiny Restharrow, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family, Fabaceae. The Spiny Restharrow has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, as well as its use as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Ononis spinosa subsp. masquillierii include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
